# The One Big Idea {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

When you "talk to AI", you talk to **two things**

## Two Layers, Stacked {auto-animate=true}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.fragment .fade-in}
::: {style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center;"}
**The Model Layer**

"The brain in a jar"
:::
:::
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.fragment .fade-in}
::: {style="background: #00C9A7; color: #ffffff; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center;"}

::::

. . .

Tell these apart and every "memory", "Projects", and "Skills" feature stops being magic.
:::

# The Model Layer {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #9B8EC0)"}

The brain in a jar

## A Brilliant Brain — With Amnesia {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="brain" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #9B8EC0;"}
A brilliant graduate's brain floating in a **jar**. It has read most of the internet,
so it's clever — but it has **total amnesia**.
:::

. . .

::: {.incremental}
- Knows nothing about *you*, your work, or what you said five minutes ago
- The instant it finishes answering, it **forgets everything**
- All it does is **predict the next word** from the text it was just handed
:::

## It Just Predicts the Next Word {auto-animate=true}

Under the hood it does **one** thing: guess the **next word** based on probability.

::: {data-id="predict" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 0.7em 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #9B8EC0; margin: 0.5em 0;"}
*"The capital of Saudi Arabia is…"*
:::

::: {style="font-size: 0.95em;"}
::: {.fragment .fade-in-then-semi-out}
- **Riyadh** (99.8%) ✅
:::
::: {.fragment .fade-in-then-semi-out}
- Jeddah (0.1%) · Paris (0.00001%)
:::
:::

. . .

It doesn't *"know"* geography — it knows **"Riyadh" almost always follows that sentence.**

## When It Guesses Wrong (Hallucinations) {auto-animate=true}

::: {style="font-size: 1.1em; margin-bottom: 1em;"}
What happens when it doesn't know the answer? **It guesses.**
:::

*"According to Article 214 of the new Investment Law: …"*

. . .

::: {.fragment .fade-in}
- **The** (45%) · **Foreign** (30%) · **Capital** (15%)
:::

. . .

::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #FF7A5C; margin-top: 1em;"}
It constructs a sentence that *sounds* right, but it has never read the actual document.
That confident, made-up answer is a **hallucination**.
:::

## The Limit That Explains Everything {auto-animate=true}

::: {style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 1.5em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.15em;"}
The model is **stateless**. It does not "remember" and it does not "look things up".
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
Anything you want it to "know", you must **hand it every single time**.
:::

# The App Layer {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

The office around the brain

## We Build an Office {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="office" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7;"}
The brain in a jar can't open files or remember your name. So we build an **office**
around it: filing cabinets, a notebook, a standing to-do list.
:::

. . .

Every time you ask for something, the office **gathers the relevant pages and hands
them to the brain** along with your request — then files the answer back.

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
The brain still has amnesia. The *office* is what makes it feel like it remembers.
:::

## What It Really Is {auto-animate=true}

::: {style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.1em;"}
The **app** (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, an agent…) is the software wrapped around the model.
:::

. . .

It **stores your information in files / a directory** and **re-sends the relevant parts
on every request**.

. . .

::: {.callout-tip}
## The features you've seen
"Memory", "Projects", "Custom Instructions" are all just the **app** doing this
gathering-and-resending for you.
:::

## The Sentence to Remember {auto-animate=true}

::: {style="background: #00C9A7; color: #ffffff; padding: 1.5em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.1em;"}
The model **knows nothing and forgets everything**;
the app **re-sends what matters on every request.**
:::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; margin-top: 1em;"}
Every "smart" feature is just the app getting smarter about **what to re-send.**
:::
